description: Sets the price for a traffic ticket (court + fee per citation) and texts the client a link to sign and pay. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

citations.description: One entry per citation to charge (1-5).

violation.description: As it goes on the agreement, e.g. "Speeding, 25 mph or more over".

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

court.description: Court name, e.g. "Collin JP 4". Defaults to the court read from the ticket.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

needs_id.description: When true, the client is asked to upload their ID first (courts that require it).

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

send.description: sms (default) texts the client a link to sign and pay; none returns the link to you.

name: quote_ticket
title: Quote a traffic ticket
